pages.text: EDTA grips a metal ion with six bonds; the tighter its binding constant, the surer the catch. Each pass removes a share 1 − e^(−K·c/f) - and the column holds only so much: too much flow for the dose and it is saturated.
$(thing)Set$(): Flow, EDTA dose.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Feed strength: the load varies by ±3%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The column is saturated.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): More flow, more throughput.
